value.q: How do I find an idea in the Idea bank?
a: Open Plans, then Planning resources, then Idea bank.
Choose a group, such as Paint or Outdoor spaces, or type in the search box.
Open Filter by what it feeds, Filter by what it supports or Filter by setting to narrow the cards.
Tap a card to read it. For educators and At home switch with one control.
value.label: Idea bank
value.words: idea bank invitation provocation material space interest season card find

value.q: How do I print Idea bank cards?
a: Open a card and tap Print this card, or tick the cards you want in the list.
Tap Select all shown to tick every card in view, then Print selected.
Choose For educators or At home first. Each card prints on its own page, as PDF or Word.
value.label: Idea bank
value.words: idea bank print card selected educators home

value.q: How do I use What are you seeing?
a: Open the Idea bank and tap What are you seeing?
Type what you see in a word or two, such as throwing or covering ears, and choose the closest one.
Read what the child might be seeking, the first steps and keeping everyone safe, then the ideas that may help.
Tap Start a team inquiry with this. The director starts the inquiry with those needs and supports, or hears your suggestion.
value.label: Idea bank
value.words: behavior seeing throwing biting climbing child needs inquiry idea bank

value.q: How do I use an Idea bank card in a plan?
a: On a curriculum plan, tap Find an idea.
The Idea bank opens with the cards that match the plan's own words, space and focus.
Tap Use in plan. The card is attached and prints after the plan.
Attach from our libraries finds Idea bank cards too.
value.label: Idea bank
value.words: idea bank plan find use attach card

value.q: How do I suggest an idea or a change to a card?
a: Open the Idea bank and the card, then tap Suggest a change. Choose the part and write the new wording.
For a new idea, tap Suggest a new idea at the top of the Idea bank.
Your suggestion waits for the director, who approves it or sets it aside.
value.label: Idea bank
value.words: idea bank suggest change new idea card

value.q: How do I edit, add or remove an Idea bank card?
a: Open the card and tap Edit. Change any part, write a short note and tap Save.
Under Earlier versions, tap Restore this version to bring back earlier wording.
Tap Add a card, choose its kind, group and title, and write it in Edit.
Tap Remove this card to take it away. Removed cards wait under Removed cards with Put it back.
value.label: Idea bank
value.words: idea bank edit add remove card restore version

value.q: How do I approve Idea bank suggestions?
a: Open the Idea bank. Suggestions waiting shows at the top.
Tap Approve to make the change or add the new card, or tap Set aside.
Approving a suggestion to start a team inquiry opens the new inquiry.
value.label: Idea bank
value.words: idea bank suggestion approve set aside

value.q: How do I highlight ideas for families?
a: Open a card with an At home side.
Tap Highlight for families.
Families see it first on the Family page, under Happening at school now.
Tap Highlighted for families to take it off.
value.label: Idea bank
value.words: idea bank highlight families family page home

value.q: How do I share an Idea bank card on Instagram?
a: Open a card with an At home side and tap Share.
Choose a photo from our documentation. Photos where a face may show are set aside.
Read the pictures and the caption, then tap Make the pictures.
Nothing posts until you post it yourself and mark it Posted.
value.label: Idea bank
value.words: idea bank share instagram post carousel home

value.q: How do I find possibilities to try in a team inquiry?
a: Open the inquiry. The director chooses what the child might be trying to get, and which senses might be asking for more or for less.
Possibilities to try shows matching Idea bank cards, with why each connects.
Tap We'll try this to add a card to What we will try. Nothing is added unless the team chooses.
value.label: Idea bank
value.words: inquiry possibilities try idea bank needs senses
